is a Hemomantic rite designed to compress raw, carnal energy—pain, suffering, and vitality—into a concentrated

, a crystalline essence of life force that can be used for powerful Hemomantic spells and enchantments. This ritual is not for the faint-hearted, as it requires the Hemomancer to channel and contain immense suffering within a single, tangible core.

is a rare, Hemomantic construct—an organic filament woven from the very essence of blood and life force. It is neither fully alive nor entirely inanimate, existing in a state of perpetual vitality, pulsating faintly with the rhythmic thrum of a heartbeat. Created through forbidden Hemomantic practices, these threads are prized for their ability to bind, mend, and control life itself.

A staple among master Hemomancers,
represents the fusion of flesh and craftsmanship, a perfect balance between creation and consumption. Those who wield it must understand its hunger—lest they become its next meal.
, a Hemomantic material that pulses with faint vitality. The set consists of a Hood, Robes, Leggings, and Boots. Each piece is dyeable, allowing Hemomancers to customize their appearance.

The living fibers of the armor draw upon blood-infused mana channels to amplify the wearer's arcane capacity, making this set ideal for Hemomancers who also practice sorcery.

Harbingers see blood not merely as a resource, but as a conduit—a bridge between the mundane and the arcane. Their magic is visceral and direct, fueled by sacrifice and the raw will to reshape the world through carnal power.

is a corrupted arcane focus—a mana trapezohedron that has been shattered and infused with Hemomantic energy. Its crystalline structure still hums with residual mana, but the cracks glow with a dark crimson light, evidence of the blood magic that now courses through it.

are corrupted forms of the arcane material Vinteum, tainted by prolonged exposure to Hemomantic energy. While standard Vinteum serves as the backbone of Mana and Artifice's crafting, its befouled counterpart channels blood-infused mana—making it essential for crafting Hemomantic artifacts that require both arcane and carnal components.
